oboecraft.answer_menu.title: Answer menu
oboecraft.review.banned: Banned after a fail. Try again in %s.
oboecraft.progress.broken: Your Oboecraft progress file couldn't be read, so you start with empty progress. The broken file was kept as %s.
oboecraft.progress.too_new: Your Oboecraft progress was saved by a newer version of Oboecraft. Update Oboecraft to play here.
oboecraft.progress.unreadable: Oboecraft couldn't read your progress file. Check your game's log.
oboecraft.progress.in_use: Your Oboecraft progress is in use by another running game. Close that game and join again.
oboecraft.progress.too_large: Your Oboecraft progress file is too large to send. Check your game's log.
oboecraft.progress.upload_timeout: Your game didn't send your Oboecraft progress in time.
oboecraft.progress.save_failed: Oboecraft couldn't save your progress. Check your game's log.
oboecraft.protocol.mismatch: This server needs the Oboecraft mod, with network protocol version %s. Install the same version of Oboecraft as the server.
oboecraft.word_list.title: Word list
oboecraft.settings.title: Oboecraft settings
oboecraft.settings.clickable_buttons: Clickable buttons in the answer menu
oboecraft.settings.review_item_scale_hin: Changes the item image above the answer field for all items. Other item images keep their normal size.
oboecraft.settings.server: Settings for singleplayer and worlds opened to LAN
oboecraft.settings.server_remote: This server's settings, which only its owner can change
oboecraft.settings.demotions: Levels a fail drops, one for each level
oboecraft.settings.tsukumogami_threshold: The overdue count the tsukumogami appears at. 0 turns it off.
oboecraft.settings.tsukumogami_review_fr: How long the tsukumogami stands still during one review, like 1m. 0s means it never does.
oboecraft.settings.save_failed: The settings couldn't be saved. See the game log.
oboecraft.tsukumogami.arrived: A tsukumogami is following you. Review your overdue items to drive it away.
oboecraft.tsukumogami.no_sleep: You can't sleep while a tsukumogami follows you
